title: cute blanket
text: cute blanket. Love the bright colors and sea theme, I just wish that the soft side was of higher quality, but I guess for the price, what can I expect. It says on the packaging to wash it to soften up blanket, so I will try that.

product_metadata.title: Lush Decor, 60 x 50, Blue Sea Life Throw Blanket
features: Care Instructions: Machine Wash Cold, Gentle Cycle, Only Non Chlorine Bleach When Needed, Tumble Dry Low, Cool iron if needed
description: Let the kid in you come out and dive into the magic world of sea life surrounded with fish, reefs and colorful ocean floor. Face of the throw adds fun to the decor with its print details while reverse of the throws Sherpa. Made from 100% cotton, soft to the hand and has wonderful quilting details.

details.Care instructions: Machine Wash Cold, Gentle Cycle, Only Non-Chlorine Bleach When Needed. Tumble Dry Low, Light Iron If Needed.
